headline: Minnesota State and UMary both lose at home
dek: Central Missouri won at UMary and Missouri Western at Minnesota State on the season's last day, with the two sides level on points at the top of the table. It was Minnesota State's second defeat of the season, against seventeen wins, and Northern State lost at Pittsburg State the same day.
